Section: Overview

Controls:
- Use arrows to move through the chooser
- Enter selects the highlighted action
- Search opens the smart command palette (names, aliases, task words)
- Preview opens action previews for the current menu
- Help reopens this quick controls overlay
- Esc goes back
- optional shortcuts are on

Palette examples:
- try: first run, triage, bundle, report, logs, doctor

Actions:
- dashboard: Open: live operations dashboard [d]
- status: Open: current status snapshot [s]
- back: Back to main menu [b]
